    try:
        print(f'{label}: OK {db.execute(sql).fetchall()}')
    except sqlite3.OperationalError as exc:
        print(f'{label}: FAIL {exc}')

check('After up migration / old reader (rollout and rollback-first step)', old)
check('After up migration / new reader', new)

check('After down migration / old reader', old)
